notes.title: v1.0.3 Patch
notes.notes:
Additions
Invert mouse look settings (Vertical and horizontal)

Invert change slot setting

Click chat messages to copy their user ID

Click players in the scoreboard to copy their user ID
Changes
Reduced the amount of XP required to gain levels (Your current level will increase)

Gamemode XP can now be fully earned while playing with bots

Level cosmetic unlock order adjusted (First 10 levels)

Chat messages now persist when changing maps

“No Bots” vote denominator now represents the amount of votes required to remove bots

“Ready” vote denominator now represents the amount of votes required to start the game
Fixes
Long usernames cut-off in kill confirmed text

Lobby countdown sometimes stopped

Loading doesn’t immediately start when joining a server

notes.title: v1.0.2 Patch
notes.notes:
Additions
Setting to invert the flash screen effect (white to black)

Max bots lobby setting

Scope crosshair size setting
Changes
Your “No Bots” vote will now persist between games

The max amount of bots will now default to 12 (Before it was the servers max player count)

Ammo pickups now refill throwables (3rd hand slot)

Increased new chat message display time from 2.22 to 5 seconds

Flash improvements

Reduced flash effect max range from 60 to 30

Removed the ringing sound

Low pass filter for the audio effect
Fixes
Issues that caused the server to freeze/crash

notes.title: v1.0.1 Patch
notes.notes:
Patch v1.0.1[hr][/hr]Additions
New main menu and lobby music composed by Dubscr
Changes
Empty player slots are now populated with bots by default when in game

Vote "No Bots" in the lobby to remove bots from the next game (Requires 20% vote count)

"Auto Vault" controls setting is now off by default

notes.title: X-Mode 1.0 Release
notes.notes:
Update v1.0.0[hr][/hr]
After 5 years of development X-Mode will be available free-to-play September 19th!
Additions
World space capture point names

Flag stolen UI in Capture The Flag gamemode

Grass render distance setting

“Aim Time” item info UI

Idle players will be kicked after idleKickTime server property (Default 60 seconds)

Per player voice chat mute

/help command that lists all available commands
Changes
Mountain Temple map has been fully detailed

Recoil adjustments

Reduced recoil on all automatic guns

Gun recoil is no longer increased while moving

Gun recoil spring back amount now adjusts to compensation from player input

Increased other player footstep volume

Race checkpoint numbers are now visible through walls

Increased proximity chat distance

timeoutTime server property time unit changed from milliseconds to seconds

Improved cosmetic progress screen UI
Fixes
Elimination border appeared when it shouldn’t

Physics objects not affected by lifts/jump pads

Player level in scoreboard didn’t increase between rounds after levelling up

Rare chance that players were unable to move after respawn

Issues with server console input on Linux

Throwables would appear to begin throwing but fail if item is still equipping

Issues with setting slider fields
